description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It tests methods related to authentication provider retrieval, initiation of authentication, URL generation, user retrieval, setting user identity, and handling OpenID Connect authentication.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SocialMediaAuthenticationService, contains various test cases to verify authentication flows, provider retrieval, URL generation, user identity assignment, and handling OpenID Connect authentication.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing the SocialMediaAuthenticationService and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Verifies that getAuthProviderDao() returns an instance of AuthProviderDao.

methods.name: testInitiateAuthentication
methods.description: Tests the initiation of authentication, ensuring correct client secret, client ID, scopes, and redirect URL are configured.

methods.name: testGetRedirectURL
methods.description: Tests the URL generated for redirect during authentication.

methods.name: testGetScope
methods.description: Verifies that getScope() returns the expected scope string.

methods.name: testGetUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of User entities based on email usernames embedded in UserCredential.

methods.name: testSetOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Checks that the user identity is correctly set with provider details.

methods.name: testHandleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Verifies the handling of OpenID Connect authentication process and session interactions.
